## What you need to do

Upgrade with pip:

```
pip install --upgrade "whyknot-yt-dlp-plugins @ https://github.com/{full-repo}/releases/download/{tag}/{wheel-name}"
```

If a specific extractor in this release misbehaves on a real URL: include the URL, the full `yt-dlp -v` output, and the version line (`yt-dlp --version` plus `pip show whyknot-yt-dlp-plugins`) when reporting the bug.
